summary.result: Dataset C and Dataset D, which incorporated GLCM texture features, achieved accuracy levels similar to those of Dataset A, which used RGB alone, indicating that GLCM texture features did not substantially improve the detection of PWD-affected trees in 5-cm-resolution imagery.
summary.background: Four datasets were constructed: Dataset A, consisting of three RGB channels; Dataset B, combining RGB with elevation and aspect (5 channels); Dataset C, combining RGB with three Gray-Level Co-occurrence Matrix (GLCM) texture features, namely angular second moment (ASM), Entropy, and Homogeneity (6 channels); and Dataset D, combining RGB with the GLCM texture features and topographic information, namely elevation and aspect (8 channels).
summary.method: In the accuracy assessment, the YOLO26-L baseline model trained with Dataset B achieved the highest mean Average Precision (mAP)@50 of 0.63 among the 12 combinations.
